verdict: Every previously unrun commercial candidate now has a measured exact result or license disposition. ZPAQ method 5 remains smallest on the descriptor row and real PLY; Rust Lepton is 2.510399% smaller than production JXL on the identical one-JPEG input. This host result nominates Lepton for isolated iOS and physical-phone validation but does not promote production.
